lines.say: Every seven years, your whole city forgets everything. You found a note from yourself.
Under the floorboard. Your handwriting. Dated seven years ago.
It says. In seven days the city resets again. Don’t let them take your memories.
You check the date. Six days left.
The last line. Whatever happens, don’t trust the tower. It doesn’t forget.
Would you trust the note? Part two next. Write it in the comments.
